page.notes: Page is a single column; no marginal notes. The catchword "tur" is at the lower right. Some letters are faint or worn, especially the long-s forms and the abbreviations "nō", "q" and "cùm", which are transcribed as printed. The running head is set in small capitals and read as CAUSAS (printed CAVSAS), with u/v corrected. The printed "eft" forms have been written "est" and the long s has been normalised to s throughout.
